result.finding: No explicit Docker version requirement is specified in the project. The README references Docker Desktop without pinning a version. No docker-compose.yml, CI/CD workflows, or version-specific Docker features are present in the asset-manager directory. The use of 'az acr build' in the deploy script (which uses Azure Container Registry remote build) implies any modern Docker CLI compatible with Azure CLI is sufficient.
evidence: README.md line 131: 'Docker (https://docs.docker.com/desktop/): Required for running the application locally' — no version pinned
No docker-compose.yml found — no Compose version field to inspect
No CI/CD workflow files found under asset-manager/.github/workflows/
scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh uses 'az acr build' (remote ACR build), not local Docker daemon — no local Docker version requirement enforced
values: Minimum implied: Any Docker Desktop version supporting 'docker run' (19.03+)
No Docker Compose version specified (no docker-compose.yml present)
